steps.name: The Start of a New Day
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Lena] in 「Nidaros」.

steps.name: Back to Glaston
steps.objective: Talk to [Lena] in 「Nidaros」, then talk to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」 and turn in the quest to [Leticia].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hm? Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you thinking about?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Nothing much... Ready to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Look at the time already. It's a shame I didn't get to enjoy the Ash Wave properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You enjoyed it so much that Embla begged you to stop and leave.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It was valuable time spent strengthening friendly ties with Nidaros as a representative of the Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father Askren said he'd see us off, but thanks to you, he's too hungover to get up.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: From that little...? Hmm... Enough about the priest. Did you tell the angel you're leaving?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I quietly went to say goodbye at dawn.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, I should have mentioned it earlier. There was something I wanted to ask her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The villagers said they'd seen a young nobleman with sharp eyes. He wasn't Lord Muller, the man I'm looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then who was it...? Wait, has something happened to Lord Muller?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know exactly. But his whereabouts are unknown, so I've been asking wherever my missions take me.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I didn't learn anything here, either. I wanted to ask whether the angel knew anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find out. Wait a moment. Oh, Lena?
(Lena reaches out and catches %s's arm.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I appreciate the thought. You already have so much to do. I don't want to burden you with this, too.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Don't worry. It'll be all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so, Lena... All right.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thank you for understanding. Oh, I almost forgot.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I sent a letter to the palace saying our work is finished. We'll need to see Her Majesty when we reach Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was planning to tell her in person anyway.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Good. Then let's return to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, %s! Lady Lena! It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, how have you been?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Nothing happened in Glaston, I hope?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's been a little busy, but nothing major. Did your mission go well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to everyone's help, we finished safely.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm glad. I'm really curious about what happened, but I won't ask! Secret missions only shine when their secrets are kept.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I like this one.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe. I like you too, Lady Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll invite you to my home sometime.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, really? Thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, when are we going to see Her Majesty?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Could you wait here a moment? It won't take long. I'll stop by the government offices.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I'm done with work today. Want to chat while we wait for Lady Lena?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: The Shadow of Despair
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」, then use the portal ahead to meet [Kaina]. After talking to [Kaina], go to the front of 「Oracle Chamber」 in 「Eidos Sanctuary」.
2. Once everything is over, turn in the quest to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ever since Glaston returned to normal, the offices have been busy. The Magic Bureau with those creepy mages certainly deserved to be closed.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You know those nobles who sided with Chairman Aaron in the assembly? They used to obey his every word like Prirings rolling over and showing their bellies.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: But now that Aaron apparently never existed, they're saying the chairmanship has been vacant for ages and deciding who should take it.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The funny thing is, they all keep telling each other to do it. Rumor has it the imperial family uncovered lots of noble corruption. Maybe that's why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. So that's what's been happening.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: This isn't just about Glaston, but the palace recently decided to reorganize the institutions dealing with magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean the magic academy and the Tower of Sages?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. As part of the Magic Bureau reforms, the Tower of Sages was temporarily closed, and Xerenis Magic Academy was ordered to suspend classes.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The academy's order has already been lifted, so it probably felt like a vacation. But the Tower of Sages is taking longer than expected.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't know all the details.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know quite a lot for someone who doesn't know the details.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I heard things while patrolling the administrative district, and Silvia told me some of it herself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Is Glaston going to be all right now?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It has to be. If it isn't, I'll do something about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's reassuring.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: So keep your chin up too, %s. You've done great so far. You'll do great in the future, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe. Oh, Lady Lena's coming.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Sorry to keep you waiting. Time to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, we'd better go. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Leticia, until next time.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Goodbye, both of you!

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Your Majesty...
(Kaina welcomes them with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm glad you both returned safely.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We intended to visit you at the palace. I didn't expect you to be here.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I thought you would arrive soon, so I came out despite Argent's objections.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty, coming from the palace to the square or administrative district is fine...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: But going all the way to the Void Sea without telling anyone is dangerous.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, Argent. How did you know?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You may have concealed your identity, but you left too many traces for me to ignore.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. There was somewhere I simply had to go.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I will hear about that later.
(Kaina turns toward Lena and the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now, will you tell me what happened in Nidaros?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I report the events in Nidaros to Kaina.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Awakening the ancient Wings to crash them into another ancient ruin and destroy the world...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: In any case, thank you both for your efforts...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I did very little compared with %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. Lady Lena was a great help.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's hard to understand Daphne's actions, but she must have her reasons.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: She disposed of Aaron to protect her child, and now intends to kill even a god...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: She doesn't seem to pose an immediate threat to the Empire, but we must consider how to respond.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, you've worked hard. You've had so much to do that you can hardly have rested... Take a few days off, then go look for Lord Muller.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I will speak with your superior.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If only my ability were stronger, I might have found him... I'm sorry I learned nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her Majesty knew, too. I suppose it would be stranger if she didn't.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, I will contact you separately if I need your help.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Understood, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty... Have you had any other visions recently?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I have, but only trivial ones.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The young man who tends the square giving flowers to his sweetheart, or Silvia going to a performance by Pop'n Star Daisy...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If I see anything important, or realize I missed something, I'll let you know. What will you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll discuss it with Iris.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I want to thank you once again, %s. You resolved what the Empire had been unable to.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I now intend to set the Magic Bureau in order and redefine what magic means within the Empire.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It will take a long time to wash away the sins those fools committed...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: But that is the atonement the Empire can offer the continent of Freios...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And a necessary step toward living together with others.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Is it that late already? I must meet with the nobles of the assembly, so I will take my leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty. Until next time.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Take care on your way back, both of you. Your Majesty, shall we?
(Lena and the adventurer bow as Kaina leaves.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty and the Empire will have increasingly busy days ahead...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You're going to see the goddess now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should. What about you?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty ordered it, so I'll go home and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, then. Get some good rest.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Take care.
(Eidos Gateway. As the Oracle Chamber draws near, the adventurer's feet stop of their own accord.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this feeling? Something's strange...
(I look around, but see only the familiar scenery of Eidos from my visits to Iris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I imagining things? Whew... All right, let's go in.
(As the adventurer steps toward the Oracle Chamber, someone watching from a distance slowly reveals herself.)

lines.speaker: 거울을 든 여성
lines.text: Such keen instincts. As expected of the goddess's adventurer. Hehe. Enjoy your meeting with Barbatos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wh-what? It's the Oracle Chamber I always visit, but why does it feel so ominous...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris! Iris!
(The veil blocking my view lifts. In place of Iris's usual smile stands the figure who always greets the adventurer with a sneer.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I've been waiting, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos? Wait, Iris... Where is Iris?!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I came to talk...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What have you done to Iris?!
(Barbatos casually deflects %s's furious charge.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As I thought, you have no intention of listening. The goddess is where she belongs.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why should I believe you?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Such little faith in a god...
(Barbatos's presence vanishes for an instant. His next blow sends %s flying.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I-I have no strength... I have to hold on...)
(Barbatos raises his gunblade and throws it straight into %s's abdomen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaaaaaaaah!
(Barbatos looks down indifferently at the fallen adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... Ghh... Barba...tos...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...Still have the strength to struggle? You could have avoided this pain if you'd listened from the start...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I don't intend to kill you here. You were never someone who dies easily, anyway... And ending it like this isn't my style.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I was going to tell you this is a false realm modeled after the Oracle Chamber, posing no danger to the goddess...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: All of this is the result of your impatience. Now, listen as you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. What do you want to talk about?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How do you intend to deal with Daphne?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As expected, you have no answer.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You know that living beings, even those influenced by divine power, are almost entirely incapable of destroying a god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You saw the messenger Ell-Larsa perish yourself, didn't you? That is the law of this world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But... what if it were possible? If someone knew a way that defied the world's laws, and could wield it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne...?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Daphne has killed many witches and accumulated their power, all for the sake of 'her child.'

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: For someone who was already a monster to openly declare that she will kill a god...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The goddess Hecate is no easy opponent, but Daphne's power may already surpass hers.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s. What do you think happens to someone who kills a god? It never ends with just one.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: They become consumed by an inexplicable obsession, seeking out and killing the few gods that remain.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There was someone like that in the past. They killed an evil god, became a Deicide, and achieved their goal, yet did not stop.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Tell me. Do you think Daphne will spare the goddess Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. Barbatos... That...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That is why I have a proposal. If you do not wish to witness Iris's end...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Or, conversely, if you do not wish her to witness your death, become mine.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I promise you. I will show you a better path.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. Shut up...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't offer that nonsense as though you're doing me a favor. An unworthy demon, overstepping... You could never be a god... Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Worthiness... You speak of worthiness...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Very well. Your wishes are clear... Not that I expected anything from the start...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This world is doomed to perish. I merely offered you a choice with some chance of success. What a pity.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will prepare a stage soon. A stage where you and your goddess will witness each other's end...
(Barbatos smiles faintly, raises his gunblade, and aims at the adventurer's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My body won't move...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now I shall send you to your goddess.
(With those words, the cold blade descends, and the adventurer's vision shatters into white.)
(Then, somewhere, comes the sound of breaking glass.)
Crash!

steps.name: His Footsteps
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then turn in the quest to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Gah!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris... Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Take a deep breath first, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah... Huh? Just a moment ago, Barbatos was...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That strange presence I sensed outside the Oracle Chamber... Could it have been...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Iris about my encounter with Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: One moment...
(Iris clasps her hands, closes her eyes, and prays. Tiny lights drift down from above and fill the space.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've purified all of Eidos. It should be safe now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos said it was a fake, but seeing the Oracle Chamber like that... It was chilling.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If he knows this place, his claim to have been a god may be true. He made an identical space and waited there...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But he couldn't have done it alone. Perfectly controlling a space that doesn't exist is difficult even for a god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe the reason I'm alive and unhurt after all those attacks is the power of someone helping Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. That may also be why I couldn't hear your voice in Nidaros, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Sometimes I see a kind of current through the gaps in the great wall. I call it the presence of destruction approaching Etoile...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It is a mixture of many forms of malice, and sometimes it takes the shape of particular people...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I saw them closer than anyone else. Daphne and Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even now, two more witches have lost their lives and powers to Daphne.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And Barbatos is revealing his movements as though deliberately...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Nidaros, Knossos, and even the place where the Tower of Sages stands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He may have gone to Nidaros because of Daphne, but why Knossos and the Tower of Sages?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is he following Daphne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better hurry.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Will you be all right going without a rest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. No problem at all.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right. I'll soon finish putting part of the great wall in order. Hold on until then. I'm sorry. I'll join you as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And don't worry too much if you can't hear my voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go to Knossos and find out. Talos might know something about Deicide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I'll be back. See you later.

steps.name: Searching for Clues
steps.objective: Talk to [Talos] in 「Knossos」, then turn in the quest to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I knew we'd meet soon, but I didn't expect this. Despite all my scolding, you came and cleaned so diligently.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's nice and clean now. In return, I'll tell you what you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you already know what that is.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Sit quietly here and listen. Want a snack?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, thank you. Please go on.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As you've probably guessed, I'm not actually Talos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I call you Daedalus?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Call me whatever you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Sigh. All that traveling has made you better at winding people up.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: All right. Here's what I can tell you. What would you like to hear first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: During the Sky of Chaos, countless factions fought for supremacy across the continent.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Until then, we had no interest in what beings outside Creed did. We simply thought we should stay out of one another's affairs.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Unaware that this attitude was gradually isolating us, we came under attack from humans.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They raided our forest, claiming they had to defend themselves from filthy, greedy, cruel beastkin.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They clearly wanted something, and we spent our days in fear, not knowing what it was.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Then one day, a mage from Silvaria arrived and requested an audience with King Minos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: King Minos intended to extract information from him and kill him, but apparently took a liking to him and changed his mind...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xerenis...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes, Xerenis. We agreed to cooperate... But Talos ruined everything.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Talos and I were something like priests guarding Creed Forest. Empty titles in a world without gods, but we were still seeking a way to resist the human attacks.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: We heard there was a being like a living god in the southwestern sea and went to see him. Glaucos. Meeting him did nothing to change Creed's plight, though.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I was ready to accept Creed's collapse, but Talos was different. He resorted to forbidden methods.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A frail mortal, he found a gap in the great wall that only the God of the Astral Realm should command, and met our people's ancestral god, who had fled to another world.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Talos begged the ancestral god to save our people, but he said he had no attachment to our world and would return to his own. He had already grown comfortable with another world's peace.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Enraged, Talos apparently stabbed him with a weapon he'd prepared. A god, destroyed by his own descendant...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You must find it absurd to hear. How could a god die like that...?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Weak yet strong, strong yet weak. Not so different from this world's living beings. Well, afterward, Talos's mind collapsed as the price for killing a god.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: With his mind broken, my younger brother began blaming our people's incompetence for everything.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: At first he cursed and murdered our own kin. Then he began kidnapping them alive and handing them over to Silvarian mages...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Not knowing any of this, I still clung to the futile hope that my brother and I would save Creed.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Then I saw it. My brother had become a demon, his mind filled with primal evil...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: When I learned he planned to kill everyone, including King Minos and Pasiphae, I couldn't stand by.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I sealed everyone in a safe space to sleep, then killed my brother and all the human mages who came to murder us...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I thought it was over. I believed everything had ended... But Daphne appeared, and I learned it hadn't.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Do you know what that witch said when she suddenly returned, after leaving with some of our people in the distant past?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That when I killed Talos, who had killed a god, my body couldn't withstand that power and was destroyed.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I couldn't believe it, but it was true. The body speaking to Daphne, believing itself to be me, was Talos's.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: My soul had entered Talos's body and was suppressing my brother's soul.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So that happened...)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: And so I've lived as Talos ever since. Occasionally falling victim to Daphne, meeting people like you. It's been quite something...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: My brother's soul kept shrinking until I thought it had finally vanished. Then Daphne put me to sleep recently and sent a letter saying she'd erased his soul.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I remember she couldn't even control souls before... Sigh. Now my memories of my brother really are fading.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well, that's enough. I have no feelings left toward him anyway.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Whew. Was it really for the best...? Time has passed, but we're still in an unstable world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still... Things are getting better. It'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Do you want to believe that, or do you really believe it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Both.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I'd like to believe that, too, %s.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Lord Minos?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lord Minos. How did you...?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: The goddess restored the vain flow of time binding Knossos. Thanks to her, everyone trapped there could come outside.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I sensed a strong presence in Knossos and thought it might be you. I was right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Lord Minos...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Daedalus, thank you for guarding Knossos all this time. What happened before wasn't your fault. Don't dwell on it. Didn't I tell you I'd forgiven the past?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: %s, where are you going now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To the place where the Tower of Sages stands.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: The Tower of Sages?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A magical research institute in Devesis, deep in the continent's west. It was founded after the mage Xerenis died...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Xerenis told me of a village with many people studying magic. That must be it.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Xerenis once said he'd seen Talos in Devesis, but I didn't realize what he meant...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Our people had no reason to travel that far. Could he have discovered something there...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it's connected to Barbatos appearing there...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Minos, Talos, I need to go. I'd better move quickly.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Understood. We can't keep someone so busy. Go on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Until next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How do I get there? Ah, shall I ask at Nereis Gateway first?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Lord Minos, I should go, too...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: What %s is doing now is not our task. We mustn't interfere rashly...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: We should put Knossos in order and await the goddess's summons.

steps.name: A New Gate
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」. Be sure to travel using the gate in 「Nereis Gatewayway」.
2. Go to 「Whispering Hill」. After the scene ends, defeat [Monstrous Bird Ruby] and [White Rock Troll], then turn in the quest to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Edam, this isn't revenge for the time I took leave without warning, is it?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Not at all. You accommodated me so I could finally take a proper vacation. Why would I take revenge?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sorry. I was joking.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I almost took it as my superior's true feelings: how dare I leave when we're so busy?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Well, you got me there. You've certainly improved, Edam, to make a remark like that.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: It's all thanks to you, Notos. Oh, %s? Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam, are you going somewhere?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I'm taking a few days off starting today. Come to think of it, I can tell you, %s.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I'm going to see Bjor, and visit my younger sibling and their spouse. Something good must have happened lately, because he invited me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Enjoy your vacation, Edam. Give Bjor my regards.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I will. Please speak with Notos. I'll be off.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, I was just about to contact you. There's something that appeared after the Magic Bureau matter ended. A symptom, or a phenomenon...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Anyway, it seems Aaron Tienes has disappeared from the world without a trace, including from people's memories...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Only a few people will remember him.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Then let's go to the Great %s Room. Some rather good cookies have just arrived.
(The adventurer and Notos enter the Great %s Room, talk, and come back outside.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: From the Empire's perspective, I suppose we should be relieved that a great crisis has passed...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...I'm sorry. You still have so much ahead of you, %s. I was thinking only of myself.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thanks to you, %s, I reconciled with Zephyros, learned why my father died, and even met the spirit...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't overthink it. I simply did what I needed to do. From now on, focus on your own work, Notos.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Would it be all right for me to want a little more...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, thank you. I'll never forget those words.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'd like to accompany you to Devesis, but with Edam on vacation, there's too much work at the gateway center.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh, right. I heard the Tower of Sages is currently closed. No doubt because of what happened before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get to Devesis?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Devesis is in rugged country, so the journey isn't easy. But the gate here can take you to a nearby hill.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's a fair distance from the hill to the village, but finding it shouldn't be difficult.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: And if you need help in Devesis, speak to Patello. He's an irreplaceable friend to my brother and me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is he a mage at the Tower of Sages?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes. He's quite well known in Devesis. In some ways, he may be harder to deal with than Zephyros.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hehe. He's a better person than you might expect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for everything, Notos. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You've come all this way. Why not rest a little in the Great %s Room?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, thank you. I'm in a hurry. I'd better go. See you later.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Of course. I wish you a safe journey.
(As the adventurer leaves Notos and heads toward the gate, the sound of breaking glass comes from somewhere.)
Crash...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What was that? Did I mishear?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's keep going...)
(The magical currents within the gate disperse, and an unfamiliar place opens before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The hill Notos mentioned, I suppose. Oh, over there...
(Beyond the hill, at the edge of the horizon, stands a tower topped with something resembling a mage's hat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He said the village wasn't hard to find. With that tower in plain sight, I won't get lost. Let's go...)
(Just then, something carrying an enormous jewel rushes past %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh. Even the Prirings here look like golden-brown bread. And it's carrying a huge jewel.
(The startled Priring approaches and strikes %s on the head with the jewel.)
Whack!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: 프리링?
lines.text: I'm sorry, ring. You startled me, ring. Does it hurt a lot, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if I startled you, you can't just hit me with a jewel! That hurts!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? A talking Priring?

lines.speaker: 프리링?
lines.text: Ring...? You can see me, ring? I've finally met someone who can see me, ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How could I miss a winged Priring carrying a jewel?

lines.speaker: 프리링?
lines.text: People can't see me, ring. Even if I stand in front of passing mages or travelers, they don't notice, ring. They can't hear me, either, ring.

lines.speaker: 프리링?
lines.text: They walk right past even when I block their way, ring. Oh, Marta seems to see me, ring.

lines.speaker: 프리링?
lines.text: But not as Juriring, ring. I think she just sees a wandering bird, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring?
(The Priring who called itself Juriring smiles brightly and waves the little wing holding its jewel.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm Juriring, ring! Tell me your name, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? My name is %s...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, %s, ring. I'll remember, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, where were you going?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: There's something I do every day, ring. It makes the people and animals passing through Whispering Hill happy, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: If I don't do it, the mirror will eat them, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mirror? The kind you look at your face in?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring.
(Juriring suddenly startles and hurriedly hides behind %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Bad monsters came out of the mirror, ring. I can't attack, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what was it when you hit me just now?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Me, ring? I only flapped my wings because I was startled. The monsters are coming, ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's deal with this first, then talk.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'll cheer you on from behind, ring!

steps.name: My Cheers Cannot Reach You
steps.objective:
1. Talk to Juriring in 「Whispering Hill」, then go to the windmill in the center of the hill.
2. Watch what happens in front of the 「Hill Windmill」, then defeat [Devesis Rock Spider] in 「Whispering Hill」. Turn in the quest to [Shuvie] in 「Devesis」.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They can't come this far, ring. You fought well because I cheered you on, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did feel stronger than usual...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said the monsters came out of a mirror. What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: There's a mirror that monsters come out of. I don't know where it is, either, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: But I'll make the monsters go back inside, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if you don't, the mirror eats people?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring. Some people have been eaten, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I wanted to save them, but they couldn't see me, so I couldn't, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem to be lying...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Now I'll do my work, ring.
(Juriring blinks, lifts its jewel-bearing wing toward the sky, hops a little, and begins shaking the jewel.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ring, ring. Be happy, ring. Stay healthy, ring, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ring, ring. Earn lots of Ely, ring. Rest eternally... No, sleep soundly, ring. Run away safely if you meet monsters, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, rest eternally?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A slip of the tongue, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: And finally, everyone in Devesis! Whatever you do, I'm cheering for you, ring!
(As Juriring finishes, a gentle light blooms from the jewel and spreads across the sky. It reaches Devesis, leaving warmth in its wake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That light makes me feel good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Definitely no ordinary Priring. Let's go along with Juriring for now, then head to the village.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm good, ring. That's why I cheer for people, ring. Sometimes that makes the monsters disappear or go back into the mirror.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't people get surprised when they see that light?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They can't see the light, just like they can't see me, ring. They don't notice, even though I do it every day, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Juriring, are you some kind of spirit?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring is Juriring, ring. Not a spirit, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? All right. Oh, what's that over there...?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The Blind Bird's Nest, ring. Birds with jewels for eyes live there, ring. That's why they're called blind, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They used to be magical beasts that tormented people, but not anymore, ring. It's strange, though, ring. Lots of them have been flying to Devesis lately, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?
Growl...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry, ring. I have no strength, ring. After cheering like that, I can't do anything but lie down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you eat food? Would you like this for now?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you, ring. Wow, delicious cookies, ring. But it's not enough.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, you were going to Devesis, right, ring? Let's go together, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Together?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: There's a restaurant in Devesis with delicious food, ring. I want to eat there, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I've been to Devesis often, but all I ever did was smell it, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: People can't see me, ring. I couldn't order, so I couldn't eat anything, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Huh? Whoa?
(Juriring leaps up and lands on %s's back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, heavy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Loosen up that hand... Wing holding the jewel. That hurt earlier! All right, all right. You're not heavy. We can go to Devesis together.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you, ring. Oh, something's a little strange, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?
(Juriring climbs down and points in one direction.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: There's a place on the hill my cheering didn't reach, ring. That's strange, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I should go look, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you going? Juriring, wait... Ah, already gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better follow and see what's happening...)
(In front of an old windmill on the hill, two women face each other. The woman holding a lamp extends her hand, and the cold-looking woman takes it.)

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: Don't you regret it?

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Why... should I?

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: You betrayed him.

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Are you saying you didn't? My choice dragged you along, too.

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: So what happened?

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Our former master trapped us in torment for all that time. Why are you defending him?

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: Stop threatening me...
(The woman with the ice sword frowns and points its tip at the lamp-bearing woman's throat.)

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: I told you not to say that. You know what I'll do...

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: No matter what you say, I'm going to become a demon.
(The woman with the lamp pushes the blade with a fingertip. The ice sword melts and scatters into droplets.)

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Don't forget. I can't exist without you, and you can't exist without me.

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Shh. Wait.
(Sensing someone approaching, the woman with the ice sword takes the other woman's hand and hides behind the windmill.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I don't see a mirror, ring. Only a windmill, ring. That's strange, ring. There should be a mirror, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's just a feeling?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: My feelings are fine, ring. I'll think after I eat, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then cheer here, and let's go straight to the village.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: All right, ring.
(Juriring lifts its jewel-bearing wing toward the sky, then stops.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I think someone's here, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who's here? Even if someone is, you said they can't see you. Just do it.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I get nervous with lots of people around, ring. Stage fright, ring.

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Oh, you?
(The woman with the ice sword emerges from behind the windmill and points at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Why are you talking to yourself here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... Oh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She really can't see Juriring.)

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Why did you stop talking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was talking to myself.

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: If you're a traveler, keep moving. Don't interfere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you, and why are you angry? Interfere with what?

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: I'm sorry. We didn't mean to upset you... It's nothing... I'll apologize on her behalf.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First you snap at me, then you apologize... What's going on?

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: I'm sorry. We'll be leaving now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We?)

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Don't go back on your word.

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Good.
(The woman with the ice sword smiles faintly and follows the woman with the lamp.)
(Juriring stares at the departing figure's back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was that person doing? Juriring, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I've seen lots of people who can't see me, but something was strange... ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Strange how?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I was frightened, ring. Scared, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was scary? She just seemed like an odd villager.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I remember every face in Devesis, ring. The animals, too, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I've never seen anyone like that, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then maybe she's a traveler?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Now that I think about it, you may be right, %s. A traveler, ring. Villagers don't carry weapons like that, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A lamp holding flames of resentment and a sharp ice sword, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She had weapons...? Two of them?
Growl...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry, ring. No strength. Let's hurry to Devesis, ring.
(Despite its words, Juriring leaps energetically onto %s's back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm happy to go together, but do we have to go like this?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry, ring. Hurry, ring. Otherwise I can't cheer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: We need to chase away the remaining monsters on the way, ring. Yawn... Follow the road toward the tower, ring. Yawn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... No choice. Let's just go.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You can do it, ring. I'll think about what to eat along the way, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Yaaaawn...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Zzz... Zzz...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring? Juriring! You can't leave everything to me and fall asleep!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Zzz...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was going to ask you to guide me, but you're already fast asleep. I might as well be finding the way alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Should I just leave you here?

steps.name: A Village among the Clouds
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Shuvie] in 「Devesis」, then watch what happens in front of [Patello].
2. Choose [About the Sage's Tower] from NPC [Patello]'s Talk menu and listen, then turn in the quest to [Patello] in 「Devesis」.

lines.text: Twinkle, twinkle, little jewels, shattering so beautifully ♬
(At the entrance to Devesis, a figure with beautiful long blonde hair sits on a bench, humming a strange song.)
In Eastland and in Freios, too ♩
Twinkle, twinkle, little jewels, I've come to smash you all ♪
Hehe. Shall I find someone useful, then?
(Just then, an unfamiliar traveler approaches from the road outside, looking around at the village scenery.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Devesis. That tower wearing a mage's hat must be the Tower of Sages.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want me to look at all the glittering stones? Do they have magic in them? They don't look like jewels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nicer than I expected. Oh, you're hungry? Come to think of it, so am I.
Who is that person talking to? Huh, what's this? Sniff, sniff. I smell a precious jewel.
Hey, wait a moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
Aaaah, I'm slippiiiiing!
Thud!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That startled me, ring. Is this person dead, ring? They fell and aren't getting up, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?
No... I'm too embarrassed to get up. Help me...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I know this person, ring. I don't like them, ring. They covet jewels, ring.
(The adventurer helps the fallen person up and checks their condition.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't seem hurt... But why?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: This person's job is smashing jewels, ring.
I was waiting for someone like you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
My name is Shuvie! I left home in search of jewels and came to Freios. I'm a sparkling Jewel☆Star!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're from Eastland? Lumen, perhaps?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Yes, Lumen. How do you know it? People in Freios never know anything when I mention Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well... I know some people there.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Who? Who, who?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ziskad, Yuran, Ull and Ell, Ren, and the people of the Alliance.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow, who are you? How do you know all those people?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should have introduced myself. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Huh? Huh? Woooow! I've heard that name. You met the goddess and went to heaven!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, you went to heaven, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I'd gone to heaven, I couldn't have come here.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehe. How wonderful to have a hero like you in Devesis. %s, will you be my guarantor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guarantor? For what? I'm sorry. I have things to do, so I'll have to decline.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Sniff. No choice, then. I'll have to wait for someone else.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: By the way, are you carrying a rare jewel or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.
(Juriring tightly grips its jewel and glares at Shuvie.)

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Really? That's strange. I smelled a precious jewel and thought it was you, %s. I have a good nose for jewels. Maybe I imagined it this time.
Growl...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Oh, you're hungry. There's a big restaurant a little farther in. Eat there. They have loads of delicious dishes.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: We were already heading there, ring. Ugh, I'm hungry, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Shuvie.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehe. Tell me if you change your mind. I'll be waiting. You're welcome anytime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, if we get the chance.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Bye! Take care.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: How strange. Meeting someone here who knows about Lumen. Oh, what's this?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: A jewel? Oh, no. It looks like a snake scale...
Growl...
I only just ate, and I'm hungry again.
(A man stretches lightly and looks toward the distant tower.)
I understand closing the Tower of Sages because of the Magic Bureau problem, but how long will this last...?
Grooooowl...
What a sound. That's not my stomach. Ah, that person. Huh? That person...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Just a little farther, ring. That place ahead is the restaurant, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can't you walk on your own?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry, ring.
Hey, you. Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
Who are you? I'm sensing an incredible amount of magic...
(Startled, Juriring hastily climbs down from %s's back.)
Huh? Was I imagining it? The magic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be Juriring...? Then let's try...)
(The adventurer places a hand on Juriring's head.)
What are you? Aren't you even trying to hide all that magic?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like that.
You say that, but the magic disappeared again. What exactly do you do? Magic like that is rare even among mages.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're a mage, then. I think there's been a misunderstanding... Let me introduce myself first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly introduce myself to the male mage before me.)
(After hearing the introduction, the man extends his hand for a handshake.)
Nice to meet you. I'm Patello, a mage researching at the Tower of Sages. Just call me Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I wanted to thank you if we ever met. I didn't expect to run into you like this.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'm so glad those stubborn, womanizing brothers reconciled thanks to you. Whew. They're awful. They wouldn't listen to a word I said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were circumstances...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I know some of it. The Magic Bureau's mages were plotting something evil and blackmailing Zephyros...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: So next time I see him, I'm going to hang him from a cliff in Bayuna Gorge. And while I'm hanging Zephyros there, I might as well hang all those villains, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Don't worry. I've done it a few times before. Haha.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I think this person's muscles are stronger than his magic, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Notos did tell me to find you if I needed help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can really see the tower from here. Could you tell me about it?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: The tower with the mage's hat behind me? That's the Tower of Sages, the symbol of Devesis.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It seems to have been revealed to the public around the founding of the Silvaria Empire, but records suggest it existed before then.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: How such a conspicuous tower went undiscovered for so long is still a mystery.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Long ago, an old man like a sage lived alone in the tower.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: When people who had lost their homes started coming here, he gave them land in front of it to settle on. That was the beginning of Devesis.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: He taught them magic and many other things, then left. The empty tower became a place for mages.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An old man...)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Xerenis Magic Academy teaches students to become mages, and the Magic Bureau aimed to put magic to use for the Empire's people...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: The Tower of Sages is an institute that studies officially approved subjects to advance magic itself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's difficult because we're expected to produce results steadily... But for mages with a gift for research, it suits them much better.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hmm. It feels strange being outside the tower this long.

steps.name: At the Threshold of the Clouds
steps.objective: Talk to [Patello] in 「Devesis」, then go to [Raselis]. When all conversations are over, turn in the quest to [Raselis].

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I see. Since fate brought us together, why don't we go to the restaurant and talk over a meal instead of standing in the road?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Yes, please, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I might eat quite a lot because of Juriring. Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, I don't eat as much as I look like I would, ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's fine. I eat a lot.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, you'll understand what he means when we get to the restaurant, ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Huh?
(As though sensing something, Patello looks up, swiftly opens his spellbook, and reaches toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A Jewel bird flew over, ring.
(A moment later, the Tower of Sages trembles slightly, followed by the cry of a frightened bird flying away.)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Those magical beasts with jewel eyes sometimes leave their nests and fly here. I scare them off.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: They're not a major threat, so we don't hunt them down like before. Though Peridot is a little dangerous...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: They seem to be coming much more often lately. I'll mention it to Master Marta later.
Growl...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Oh dear, our guest must be very hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's not me...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's fine. Being hungry isn't a crime. Let's go to the Cloud's Threshold.
Welcome.
(A woman in a neat chef's uniform greets the group entering the restaurant with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.
I'll show you to a table. Oh... Patello again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What's wrong with Patello?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Ahaha. I've gotten on Chef Raselis's bad side a little.
(The chef called Raselis smiles silently, then meets the adventurer's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I don't believe we've met. Are you traveling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm here on business, really. It's my first time in Devesis. It has such a lovely atmosphere.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I don't say this just because it's my hometown. The scenery is beautiful, and there are many good people. Wonderful mages like Marta, too...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Patello, are you eating here again?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: ...I believe you ate here two hours ago.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I get hungry quickly. Nothing I can do. I came again to bring a guest.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Sigh... Would you like to order?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef Raselis, you're taking orders yourself?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: My helpers aren't feeling well. I'll be handling the dining room for a few days.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: That dream again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A dream?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: People in the village have been talking about a strange dream lately. My helpers had it, too, and have been wasting away, saying their hearts ache.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I had the dream last week and had to take time off, too. Thankfully, a good rest helps.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: At some point, everyone in the village started having the same dream. They walk endlessly along a black carpet, but the atmosphere differs from person to person.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's basically a temple-like place. Some see a clear, clean sky, while others see snow-covered ruins.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I dreamed I was walking through snow-covered ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: That's why rumors say a demon causes the dream.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Priests came to investigate, but they don't seem to have found anything in particular.
Growl...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: You must be very hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's not me...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Yes, a little.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Everything on the menu is delicious, but I recommend the Blood Sugar Spike Steak.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Steak is a common dish, but ours is special.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: It's all thanks to our special sauce: a gentle sweetness, a subtle kick of spice, and savory depth perfected by Chef Rogian's skill.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: It's a dish full of memories for me. I used to come here holding my parents' hands and order it as a child. I'd love for you to try it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: One of those, please. Actually, make that two.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Certainly. I'll make them delicious.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef Raselis, I'll order everything on this page of the menu.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'll only eat this and won't come back again today.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Understood. Sigh...

steps.name: Fed and Ready to Work
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Raselis] in 「Devesis」, then go to [Marta].
2. After talking to [Marta], defeat monsters on 「Oscar Road」 to obtain a <Happy Mandrake>. Then return to [Devesis] and turn in the quest to [Marta].

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow, delicious, ring. I've never eaten anything so good, ring. I'm full, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's really delicious.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Right? That's why I can never pass by the Cloud's Threshold.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, Raselis...?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Raselis is acting strange again, ring.
(Raselis stands by the kitchen passage as though in a daze.)

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Patello, please hurry up and leave... Eat a reasonable amount and go... We're running out of ingredients. I'm sick of it... Nothing lasts with you around...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: You jerk. Stop gulping down food I worked so hard on like it's water...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: This happens often. She'll be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Now, shall we get to the point? How can I help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Just tell me what you need. I'll help however I can. I don't like complications, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there any legends about gods passed down in Devesis?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, I'm going to eat this, ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Oh, that one?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master Marta told me... A beastkin from Creed entered the Tower of Sages, gained enlightenment, and went to a nearby gorge.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: That was at the height of the Sky of Chaos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A gorge?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'm not certain, but they say the place that beastkin entered is now called the Blind Bird's Nest.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master Marta sealed part of the route long ago because it was dangerous. You'll need to speak with her if you want to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll have to meet Marta and hear what she knows.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: She'll probably be relaxing with a cup of tea about now. Let's finish eating first. I'll take you.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Oh? You cleaned your plate. You really must have been hungry.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you for the food, ring. It was delicious, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... It's delicious, apparently. I mean, it was delicious. Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Next time you come to the Cloud's Threshold, put your meal on my tab. Don't refuse. It's my way of repaying you.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wonderful, ring. %s, don't refuse. Come again with me, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd feel bad about that...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Yay, I can finally breathe! Patello is leaving at last!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef Raselis, aren't you saying that a bit loudly?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Oh, am I? I was so happy I couldn't help it...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Patello, please stop coming. But you, dear guest, do visit us again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Of course, Chef. See you later.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Whew... Now I can catch my breath and eat.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Chef Rogian's food really is delicious...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Huh? Where did the bread here go? Did Patello sneak another piece?!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Delicious bread, ring. Following %s gets me tasty food, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: So am I. I was wondering where Master Marta was, and there she is.
(An elderly, white-haired woman in a large mage's cloak gazes at a mysterious structure.)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master Marta!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Oh, Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master Marta, there you are.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I was taking a moment to gather my thoughts. There is much on my mind...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I don't believe I've met the person beside you. A guest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Marta. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s... So you're the one. I've heard a great deal about you. Your eyes are as remarkable as your name.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I'm Marta, the representative of Devesis.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I hoped to meet you someday, but didn't expect it to happen like this...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I'm so glad Notos and Zephyros reconciled thanks to you. Nemo would certainly be pleased.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard about Nemo when we went to Bayuna Gorge together.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I see. Like Notos and me, Nemo was Master Marta's student. He was at the Tower of Sages once, too.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Nemo was a good person, ring. He threw food to the birds, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I think of him from time to time. He was a truly fine mage.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: If Nemo's children ever visit Devesis, I would like to tell them how well they've done.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I doubt your arrival in Devesis is a coincidence... Shall we talk?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master, let's sit on the bench. You too, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I sit on the bench Patello shows me and ask about the Blind Bird's Nest.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The Blind Bird's Nest... As the goddess's apostle, you must have something to investigate there.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Normally, as Devesis's representative, I forbid entry... But I believe you will be all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: There is one problem, though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A problem?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The Blind Bird's Nest is dangerous. I sealed it when I was in my prime.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Now I'm a retired mage who can barely use magic. I cannot easily undo the seal on the path.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: But with Patello's help, it should be possible.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master, shall we go do it now?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: It will take some time.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s... Do you know the rare medicinal herb called mandrake?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've seen it.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Then I would like you to find a mandrake with a happy expression.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will that be enough?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Special mandrakes amplify magic, making them very useful.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: When you're ready, come back and speak with me. Patello and I will finish preparing in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I want to see a happy mandrake, ring. I haven't seen one since long ago, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Oh, this bird. It's been a while. It has visited now and then since I was young. It reminds me of a friend. Hello there...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Hello, Marta, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Marta really does see Juriring as a bird.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, I'll stay and play here for a while, ring. See you later, ring.

steps.name: Please Seal It
steps.objective: Talk to [Marta] in 「Devesis」, then turn in the quest to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta, there you are.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: You're back, %s. Welcome.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I was waiting, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought what you asked for.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: A fresh mandrake. Well done. This should be enough to undo the seal on the nest.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Patello should be finishing his meal and coming back now, too. We'll talk when everyone is here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, what have you been doing here?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Lying down and looking at the sky, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: You're watching this little bird, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Right. Marta sees Juriring as a bird.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: When did it begin...? Sometimes when this bird flew here, powerful magic would surge through the village.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I wondered whether the bird might be connected to the dreams, but that doesn't seem to be the case...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Oh, here comes Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: %s, you're back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Welcome back, Patello.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Now, let me explain.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, have you heard about the dreams the people of Devesis are having?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chef Raselis told me while we were eating.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: So you heard that everyone is having the same dream. Yes, they are walking through the same place, but at different times.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: That place is probably Devesis's distant past. And the shadow of another time.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master, how do you know that?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Twenty-five years ago, a vortex filled with magic suddenly appeared and swept over Devesis and Whispering Hill.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Ordinary beings could not sense it, but mages should have. I thought something terrible was happening.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Yet I seem to have been the only one who felt it. I followed the magical current to the Blind Bird's Nest, whose entrance I had sealed.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The moment I stepped inside, a different space unfolded in place of the familiar gorge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be...?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Yes. It was a chaotic realm filled with demons and fallen spirits someone had summoned.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: At first, I saw the warm past of Devesis. But after wandering for a long time, I found myself in a space of frozen time.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Barely surviving, I reached the end and met a spirit gazing into a jeweled mirror in that frozen place.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The spirit saw me as an enemy and attacked. There was no way out unless I defeated it.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: As I struggled against it with every ounce of strength, I suddenly felt something like a glass wall breaking behind me...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Thankfully, I seemed to have returned to our world. I could see the gorge containing the Blind Bird's Nest.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: And this book was on the ground.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I took it back to the village and told my colleagues what had happened, but no one believed me.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Only Nemo believed and helped me. Together, we found and sealed all the ominous magical currents.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: That's why anyone who enters now returns to the entrance after a short while.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: In any case, it never happened again, and I began deciphering this book.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: You're wondering why I never told you this, Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Afterward, a demon in human form appeared before me.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: He threatened to kill everyone in Devesis if I told anyone I'd glimpsed between the great walls...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Some of my memories vanished in that overwhelming terror. The shock also caused my magic to fade gradually...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: ...Only recently did those memories return. What is this great wall...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember what the demon looked like?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Not clearly. Like a black shadow dressed as a noble...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: You know something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's difficult to explain everything... But that demon was destroyed recently...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I see... In any case, I never forgot this book. I spent years trying to decipher it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does the book say anything about Devesis's past?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: All I learned was that this land was loved by a certain god, and that the path lies in a mirror...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A mirror... What does it mean? Oh, Juriring?)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: We need to check the mirror, ring!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Yes, Master.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: There are twenty-six places where the magic flows strangely. Undo every seal and examine their condition.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: If anything seems unusual, make a note and tell me.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your help, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Not at all. I'm only sorry I cannot do more.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'll help in your place, Master. Don't worry. And %s, I'm not quite ready yet...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go ahead and wait.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: All right. I'll prepare as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I hope you find the answers you seek there. Please take care.
(After everyone leaves, someone watching from atop the Tower of Sages smiles softly.)
Hehe. Peeking at that time through a gap in the great wall. How interesting.
Shall I make it more interesting?
I'll hasten Devesis's fate as a sacrifice a little. For his sake...

steps.name: A Bird Bearing Gems
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」, then enter 「Blind Bird's Nest」.
2. Defeat [Monstrous Bird Peridot] in 「Blind Bird's Nest」 and obtain the <Jewel Mirror>. Pass through the reward room and watch all the events, then go outside and turn in the quest to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The Blind Bird's Nest is just ahead, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That must be the magical beasts' nest. What else is in there?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A mirror, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that mirror is in this gorge? And monsters keep coming out of it?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring. Someone's coming, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who? Patello?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The jewel destroyer, ring.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hello, hello! Nice to see you! Waiting for the gluttonous mage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shuvie? What brings you here...?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I was lounging around the village entrance when Grandma Marta suddenly asked for my help.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I once helped dismantle a magical device she'd locked.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Apparently intricate spells sometimes require an unconventional sense for magic.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Mages in Freios and Eastland handle magic a little differently, after all.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Ahem. Does that explain it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: While I'm at it, I want to look inside, too. Remember when I asked you to be my guarantor?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: There's a jewel mine here owned by a family of jewel merchants. I want to rent access at a reasonable price.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: But there are magical beasts wandering around, and the magical barrier keeps sending me back to the entrance.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I tried undoing the barrier my own way, but stopped when they said it would take too long and be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: So I thought I might get in with someone like %s as my guarantor!

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: And now everything's working out! All thanks to a wonderful adventurer coming to Devesis. Hehe, you're a lucky charm!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lucky charm?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Yes, a lucky charm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... Oh, here comes Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Have you been waiting long?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Patello, didn't you say you had preparations to make? You look the same as usual.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: There was one part I wasn't sure about, so I ran a simulation in an outside storeroom. It's fine. Nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I've replenished my magic, too. Everything's perfect.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: He ate loads of food by himself, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I want to get into the jewel mine already.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: All right, stop pestering. %s, watch from behind. Shuvie, stand here on the left.
(Patello opens his spellbook, walks slowly around, and stops.)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Everyone, close your eyes.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: My eyes are closed, ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I can feel the magic surging. Does it connect here? All right, open your eyes.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Shuvie, when you feel me shake the magical barrier, strike its center. Just like when you smash jewels.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Oh, now?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Yes, now!

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: All right! Shuvie's One-Hit☆Smash!
(A sharp shattering sound echoes through the gorge.)
Crash.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's that sound?!)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A little mirror broke, ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: That's one undone. Twenty-five left. Come on, everyone.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: How strange. From a distance it looked like an ordinary magical beast habitat... But these oppressive energies make it hard to breathe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air feels different from outside.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Shuvie, what was that 'One-Hit Smash'?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehe, a battle cry. Jewels have to be finished in one hit.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Poor jewels, ring.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Which way is the jewel mine? I think I see something glittering up there.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Shuvie, you heard Master Marta, right?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Yes. Follow you and undo all the seals...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Then follow quietly. You're a Jewel Star who keeps promises.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: That's right! A promise-keeping Jewel☆Star!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Come on, everyone. Carefully...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, there's a mirror, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where?
(The moment I look where Juriring points, Patello and Shuvie walking ahead begin to fade away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what? Where did they go?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: There was a mirror in front of Patello and Shuvie, ring. They went inside, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They could be in danger. We need to find them quickly.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They're all right, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They're both strong, ring. They'll fight just fine, ring. One-Hit Smash for the monsters, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even so...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Let's work hard to find what we're looking for, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Oh, over there... Something seems to be swarming toward us.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring. Lots of Jewel birds, ring. Magnificent friends with jewels in their eyes, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: But they don't like anyone entering their territory, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Aaaah! It's not just birds. There are loads of Rock Trolls and Devesis Spiders, too!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No choice. We'll have to defeat them all and get through.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I think we're here, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We've searched every path in the gorge, but there's nothing... Are those two really all right?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They're fine, ring. They're working hard to undo the seals on the path up to the Blind Bird's Nest, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's how we got this far, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are they now?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They're wandering around lost, ring. They can't find the last mirror, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Another mirror? Juriring, how do you know all that? What are you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring is Juriring, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The same answer again...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, hide for a moment, ring. Someone's there, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's...
(Someone reaches toward the monstrous birds in the sky. Sharp icicles form at her fingertips and fly toward them.)
Screeech!
(Several birds are pierced by the icicles and fall from the sky.)

lines.speaker: 램프를 든 여성
lines.text: S-stop...

lines.speaker: 얼음 검을 든 여성
lines.text: Lauma, summon Peridot now. Otherwise these magical beasts will keep dying.
