lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: No, Giltine...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Are you all right with them dying one after another? Well, perhaps it's better they die by my hand than a demon's or a human's.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Giltine!

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Have you forgotten our promise? To see him again? You said you would save him.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Let's meet ▒▒▒▒ again. Only then can you escape me, too.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: I'll call Peridot. Stop killing them.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: You should have done that from the start.
(Lauma shakes the lamp in her hand, and an enormous black shadow falls across the sky.)

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Peridot...
Screeech.
(A huge bird with jewels on its body and in its eyes descends through the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wh-what? That magical beast...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Peridot is the leader of the birds, ring. Peridot doesn't come just because someone calls... ring. Who is that person, ring?
Chirp. Screech.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: I know you want to live quietly. But act once more, for his sake.
(Peridot's eyes gleam as though responding to that name.)

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Good. Peridot, find the one blessed by the goddess.
(Peridot rises into the sky and surveys the gorge.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Too late, ring.
(The enormous shadow in the sky draws closer and closer to the adventurer.)
Crash!

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Why did it come down here?

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: The traveler we saw before is there. I thought something was strange, and now we meet again like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I see... You're not human...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: So what if I'm not? Is that really what concerns you in this situation?

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Peridot, capture that person...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Don't kill them. We need to entertain Belial.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Belial?)
(Peridot stares at the wary adventurer and unleashes a roar mingling terror and emptiness, a sound impossible to hear in this world.)
Skreeeeeeee!

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Peridot...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Hurry, Lauma. Let's find that mirror.
(After a fierce battle, %s's attack destroys the jewel in Peridot's left eye, the last one remaining.)
Skreeeeee!
(Unable to bear the pain, Peridot flaps its wings and collapses to the ground.)
Crash!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. That was close...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wondered how to fight it, but the jewels were its weakness...
Scree...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Peridot, what did you say, ring?
Screee...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Understood, ring.
Chirp...
(The fallen Peridot chirps weakly as though answering Juriring. Its body slowly cools, and it stops moving.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? What?!
(Peridot's body turns black and hardens like stone. A moment later, it splits into pieces.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I suppose this was its master's wish, ring.
(Juriring finds something among Peridot's remains and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? A mirror...?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: There was a mirror inside Peridot, ring. A mirror made of jewels, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think the person who ordered Peridot to attack us was looking for it... So that person wasn't Peridot's master?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: They aren't Peridot's master, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are they looking for this mirror? Oh, could this be the mirror Marta told us about?
(Just then, the figure who went to look for the mirror reappears in the distance. Startled, the adventurer nearly drops the mirror, but catches it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Ah, that was close.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What's wrong, ring? Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person's reflection keeps changing in this mirror...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just as Juriring said, I can see a green woman holding a lamp and a woman with an ice sword in the mirror. I suspected she wasn't human, but those are her true forms...

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Peridot...?

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: The mirror we wanted was right nearby, and we wasted all that time searching.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Peridot is dead... It died because of the mirror...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: It was a magical beast destined to die anyway. The mirror only let it live a little longer.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you? And why do you want this mirror? Answer me!

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: I have nothing to say to someone about to die.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Giltine, stop. If we fight the one blessed by the goddess here, the mirror might break...
(At that moment, a tremendous tremor shakes the ground beneath everyone.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The nest is shaking, ring. The ground is splitting, ring. Huge rocks are going to fall, ring.
(As Juriring speaks, the ground between Giltine and Lauma and the adventurer and Juriring begins to split violently.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Hold tight, ring!
(Juriring tosses the adventurer onto its shoulders and races down the gorge.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! I-I'm going to be sick!
(After the adventurer and Juriring disappear, Lauma watches the shaking, splitting gorge and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Think of it as Peridot saving us the trouble of finding the mirror.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: When this is over, we'll make Peridot again. I collected the broken jewels.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: All right...
Yes, make as many as you like when this is over.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You were like this back then, too. Still talking to yourself so unpleasantly.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Belial...?
(Behind a black mirror radiating an ominous presence, a blonde woman with demonic horns slowly appears.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: And a lowly spirit dares speak my name so casually. Isn't that right?
(Belial taps the mirror's surface with a fingertip. Lauma and Giltine clutch their heads and collapse.)

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Aaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Ugh... Aaaaaagh!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Did you think you were free just because you got out of the mirror for a moment? Feels good, doesn't it? Hmm?

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: N-no... Aaaaaah...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You don't even know who let you out of the mirror...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: P-please spare me! I-I just wanted to become a demon... Gaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Then you should have asked nicely from the beginning.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Sorry. I only meant to give you a little scolding, but forgot to hold back. I've been irritated since Jennifer and Alexandra escaped recently.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: All I did was put them in and take them out of the mirror a few times.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Oh, does it hurt? Then go inside the mirror and rest.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Scared to go back in? But what can you do?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: That's why I called you.

steps.name: An Ominous Mirror
steps.objective: Talk to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」, then turn in the quest to [Marta] in 「Devesis」.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Whew, we're here, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah, I'm dizzy...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Get a hold of yourself, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, were you about to hit me with that jewel?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm glad you've recovered, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, what are you? Are you going to say Juriring is Juriring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring. Juriring is Juriring, ring. Oh, Patello and Shuvie are coming, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Juriring is definitely helping, but something feels strange. Should I ask Iris...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris, can you hear me?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nothing. Is there something powerful in Devesis interfering this time, too?)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: There you are. The inner gorge suddenly shook and split. It startled me. Now it looks fine again?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I found the jewel mine inside and went in, but there wasn't a single rare jewel. Just loads of ordinary stuff.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: At least there weren't any magical beasts on the way. I'll have to come back later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is everyone all right?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: We're fine. Shuvie's much more skilled than I expected.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Thanks! Those magical barriers sparkle, and breaking them feels like smashing jewels. I like it.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thanks to Shuvie, all the little mirrors in the nest broke, ring. One-Hit Smash, ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: What's this, though? A mirror? I can feel powerful magic coming from it...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow, what a pretty mirror. It looks perfect for smashing. Should I break this, too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think this is the mirror Marta mentioned.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow, what a pretty mirror. It looks like something we must never break. Right?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Very funny. Anyway, we undid all twenty-six seals as Master said, but found nothing unusual.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's return to the village and report to Marta.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: All right. Let's go. We need to visit the Cloud's Threshold again, too. Oh, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I've sensed it since we met. Even now, there's an enormous, unusual mass of magic behind you, %s. It doesn't seem to belong to you, %s...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Me too, me too! I sensed something. A rare, enormous jewel. That's why I asked if you had one.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: (Flinch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. I'm not sure, either.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hmm, all right. But...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Patello, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'm wondering whether leaving the seals undone will be dangerous...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Don't worry, ring. It'll be fine, ring.
(Juriring shakes its jewel. Warm light pours from the sky and spreads toward the Blind Bird's Nest.)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Well, it should be fine, right?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I smell a rare jewel again. Sniff, sniff. Oh, is it the ruby I'm holding?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Stop sniffing. Come on, back to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's go.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Oh, I'm hungry. I'm going to the Cloud's Threshold, too. Time for something delicious ♬
(Patello and Shuvie lead the way. The adventurer lingers behind, looking at the mirror they just found.)
(The adventurer turns to Juriring, who follows behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What is it, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you going to the village, too?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I have to, ring. I'm going to do my work, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What work?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Cheering, ring. I have to cheer for the village, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What for?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Cheering is cheering, ring. %s, keep standing there and I'll leave you behind, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Definitely hiding something. I don't know what, but let's see Marta first.)

steps.name: When the Name Is Called
steps.objective: Talk to [Marta] in 「Devesis」 and watch all the events that follow. Then turn in the quest to [Marta].

lines.text: (Marta looks at the mysterious structure in one corner of the village and suddenly startles.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The magic dwelling here feels so strong...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Gasp...
(Unable to endure the approaching presence, Marta sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: It's all right... It's all right... Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master! We're back!

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Grandma Marta, we're here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta, there you are. You look pale. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: It's nothing. I'm fine... You've all returned safely.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I was worried when the gorge seemed to shake. What a relief. Did you find anything unusual?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Well... Nothing besides the magical barriers you mentioned.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I must have expected too much. They called it a jewel mine, but it was tiny. The one near Lumen was decent, at least.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Compared with Ziskad's mine, it would be small...)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I see. But %s... What's in your hand? A glittering mirror...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something Peridot was carrying inside its body.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: What? You defeated Peridot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Peridot wasn't among the magical beasts we saw.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Just birds with F-grade tainted diamonds, F-grade broken rubies, E-grade useless emeralds, E-grade dirty sapphires, and D-grade stupid jaspers.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Peridot is their leader. It's dozens of times larger, too.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: You defeated that and brought this back?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: I'd better not mess with %s...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: This is the very mirror I saw that day. To think Peridot had it...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: And this mirror... It seems to be resonating with this structure.
(Marta carries the mirror closer to the structure in front of her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Oh, you're right. I can see the mirror shaking.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: How curious.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Huh? What's this?
(Marta hands the mirror to %s for a moment and hurriedly opens her book to check something.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: This can't be...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master? What is it?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: After a lifetime spent deciphering only a few lines, I can suddenly read the words...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it say?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: One moment. If I put these parts together...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: "I will abandon my name and erase everyone's memories. Here I bury every trace of suffering."

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: "Hoping this name will never be spoken again, I inscribe it here one final time."

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Kaulini...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kaulini?)
Crash...
(The moment the name is spoken, the jewel-bright mirror cracks. Through the fissure, a figure previously invisible appears.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: At last, it's complete...
(The mirror held by the black-horned woman shakes violently. Black shadows spill from its edges and swallow the entire space in an instant.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Heavens... This can't be...
(Marta cries out as she stares at Devesis, now filled with black shadows.)
(Everything visible a moment ago sinks into darkness. Nothing can be seen.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The people... Patello... Shuvie... Those dark shadows... It's all my fault...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta, get a hold of yourself!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Patello... Shuvie...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please!
(Unable to bear the dreadful sight, Marta collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta? Marta?!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Leave the old mage.
Click, click.
(The sound of high heels stepping on black shadows echoes hollowly.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Old human mage, thank you for speaking his name. I'm so happy Likimo Pelke is complete.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ha. So much for a god's name. We couldn't even properly say or hear it all this time. Isn't that funny, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Impatient, aren't you? I was just about to introduce myself.
(Holding the mirror in one hand, Belial lifts the edge of her skirt with the other and gracefully bows her head and waist.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I am Belial. A demon who deceives every emotion in the world and delights in lies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belial...?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Yes, Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: That old mage tried to endure it and collapsed. You're holding up rather well.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: This may sound like boasting, but so many demons in the Demon Realm want me. They come craving my beauty and power. How amusing.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Then they die by my hand, or destroy themselves under the terror of my power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's your point?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I heard a human fought Barbatos and survived. It caught my interest.
(The black shadows filling Devesis surge.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Barbatos seems eager for the day he can truly face you. But before that, there's something I want to try.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: As you saw, my mirror, imbued with an ancient god's memories, has swallowed Devesis.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: That means every soul in this beautiful village is trapped in a miserable past.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: And those souls will become nourishment for my mirror.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe, %s. It's been so long since I put so many human souls into a mirror. I'm thrilled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Belial!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Oh, did you already forget I'm a demon? Shouting won't help. You need to understand that you can't lay a finger on me here.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Doesn't this space look familiar?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me... You helped Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Anyone who isn't a fool could work that out.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Very well. As a demon, I'll be honest. I want your soul. I'm sure it will entertain me.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Come into Likimo Pelke. I'll face you personally as a special favor. Otherwise, everyone dies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belial!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Foolish human. Would you refuse my gracious invitation?
(Belial smiles. The mirror in her hand splits into several mirrors and floats into the air.)
(Black shadows pour from the mirrors like a river, binding the adventurer's neck, arms, and legs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... Ghh... Aaaaagh...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: The more you struggle, the deeper they'll dig into you. At this rate, you'll die trapped in these shadows without saving anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'd rather watch you die in despair than simply suffer here...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: The expression humans make when they pin their hopes on a tiny chance and it all falls apart... It's so beautiful.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: So, what will you do?
(Belial gestures. The mirrors shatter, and sharp fragments fly toward the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Will you die such a dull death?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belial, I won't let you get away with this... I won't...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I love that expression. A face twisted by emotions it can't contain... Nothing compares.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Now, %s. I invite you to Likimo Pelke, where everyone is trapped with no escape.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: When you're ready, say his name: Kaulini. Then you'll understand.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'll be waiting. Don't run away.
Crash...

steps.name: Whispers of Deceit and Lies
steps.objective:
Talk to [Marta] in 「Devesis」, then enter 「Likimo Pelke」.
2. Defeat [Belial] in 「Likimo Pelke」 and obtain the <Mirror Showing Cloud Hill>. Pass through the reward room and watch all the events, then go outside and turn in the quest to [Marta] in 「Devesis」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah... Again...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wh-what? What's wrong? You startled me.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: What's gotten into you? Hungry?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... It's nothing.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Patello, Shuvie, thank you for your work. Go and rest. I'll call again if I need your help.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Oh, %s. There's something I need to discuss. Please stay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Marta...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Then call me again next time, Grandma Marta!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Understood. Rest well, Master. We'll be going.
(After Shuvie and Patello leave, Marta quietly looks at the structure in front of the village.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Was everything that demon Belial told you true, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You remember...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because I spoke that name... How can I atone for my foolishness, deciphering the book as though it were my life's duty...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. You couldn't have known what would happen.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, do you intend to enter Likimo Pelke as the demon wants?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think that's our only option now. I experienced her ability before coming here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't explain in detail, but Belial uses mirrors to create artificial spaces and control everything inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Devesis is now under the influence of her mirror, I'll have to go inside...
(At that moment, an ominous violet light shoots from the tip of the structure into the sky, shaking Devesis.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The demon is mocking us... As though that really is our only choice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta, how long has this structure been here?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Since the village was founded, long ago. The villagers may not know, but magic has always lingered in it.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Mages spent years trying to discover what it was, but never succeeded. Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, the demon told you to speak that god's name when you were ready, didn't she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I'm ready...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, stand before it and say the name...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kaulini...
(As the name rings out, faint shadows flow from the structure and spread across the ground like a carpet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The black carpet from the villagers' dreams. If I keep walking forward, I'll enter Likimo Pelke.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I've faced worse situations. Whatever happens, I have to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta, wait here. I'll return with good news.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: All right... Please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go...
(The adventurer steps onto the demon's shadows and slowly sinks into Devesis's dreamlike memories.)
(With every step, lights and shadows of many colors mingle and fill Devesis.)
(As dozens, then hundreds of lights and shadows appear, the scenery of Devesis keeps changing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What a strange feeling...)
(As the scenery finally stops changing, the adventurer's steps naturally come to a halt.)
(A flower garden bathed in warm light, small beautiful buildings, and the remains of a collapsed temple await the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be the place in everyone's dreams... It's beautiful...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mirrors everywhere. Just what I'd expect from a space that demon made. Let's see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The scenery inside the mirror is covered in snow... Just as Chef Raselis said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This feels strange. As though the mirror is calling me...
(As the adventurer unconsciously reaches toward the mirror, an enormous shadow falls over their head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!
Thud!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, snap out of it, ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaah, heavy! Juriring?!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring isn't heavy, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, you're not heavy. Put the jewel down before we talk. I'm awake!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where have you been, anyway?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The moment the mirror broke, I was in here, ring. %s, touch the wrong mirror and you'll be trapped, ring. I'll show you the way, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'll find the real mirror, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. And another thing... No, let's just go.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Why aren't you asking more, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You won't give me a proper answer anyway. I'll assume someone sent you to help me.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: More importantly, which way do we go?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Trust Juriring and follow, ring. %s, look at that mirror, ring.
(Inside a large mirror to one side, someone lifts an enormous lamp. A woman whose entire body is green appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Her name is Ellone, ring. A spirit who helped an ancient god and prayed for the health and well-being of living things, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: But she betrayed her master, ring. She joined hands with a demon, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: She nearly vanished as the price, but survived, ring. Instead, she was cursed and split into two personalities, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It sounds a little like Oz, who ruled Emeraldia...)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The demon tempted the spirit, ring. It corrupted her and made the god start dying, too, ring.
(Hearing this, the woman inside the mirror grabs something and begins shaking it. The entire space around the adventurer shakes with it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what...?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: She's angry, ring. That's Lauma, ring.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Don't say it! I... I...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: She's Ellone's emotion that brings light to flowers and trees, ring. After falling, she carries fire and burns everything, ring.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: I had no choice... It was...
(The woman inside the mirror changes into someone else.)
(The cold-looking woman with the ice sword grabs something and shakes it again. Once more, the world trembles violently.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's Giltine, ring. Ellone's emotion that gathers droplets from clouds so water can reach flowers and trees, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: After falling, she froze the water into sharp points and stabbed everyone, ring.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Shut up! Ellone is gone. Dead. And what business is it of yours what I do?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ellone should have vanished for betraying her master, but survived, ring. She's been trapped in the mirror all this time, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trapped in the mirror, then let out? In that case...)

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Priring with the jewel... Who are you?

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Who are you, and how do you know that?!

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: ...With him gone, no one should know this... Could that Priring be...?

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Kaulini isn't some fat Priring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's rude, ring! Juriring is Juriring, ring.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: But how are you here? No one can come unless Belial brings them.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Who knows, ring?

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Tell me! Tell me!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: No, ring. I don't want to, ring. Why are you yelling when you're hiding inside like cowards, ring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, let's just go, ring. We'll have to meet Ellone on the way to Belial anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So we can't reach Belial without facing those two.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: %s, I'll kill you...

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Giltine, calm down. We have our own task for Kaulini...
(Giltine quietly nods and takes Lauma's hand. Their figures disappear from the mirror.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kaulini...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: We're short on time, ring. Juriring will guide you, ring. Follow me, ring.
(As Juriring leads the way, the large and small mirrors along the path begin breaking one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Getting to Belial won't be easy...)
(Belial smiles at Lauma and Giltine, trapped inside a mirror.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I thought you'd entertain me a little, like the adventurer.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Lady Belial! Why have you locked us up again? A little longer, and we'd have dealt with the adventurer...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll tell him you worked hard to help me.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: Stop, Giltine.

lines.speaker: 길티네
lines.text: Stop what? No, she'll give us another chance.

lines.speaker: 라우마
lines.text: The demon was never on our side...
(Lauma holds Giltine and closes her eyes as though resigned.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Lauma is clever. A demon is on no one's side. You simply believed and obeyed me.
(Belial taps the mirror with a fingertip. Black shadows rise and fill it.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Goodbye, Ellone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I heard a scream...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: %s, when did you arrive?
(Belial smiles brightly at the adventurer before her and lightly wipes the mirror, now cleared of black shadows, with her sleeve.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Welcome. It must have been quite a journey to reach me...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: As expected of someone with a soul coveted by the demons of the Demon Realm. Imperfect, yet pure and strong... That's how you made it this far.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: An ordinary human would have been trapped in a single little mirror and melted away.
(With those words, Belial vanishes from %s's sight in an instant.)
(Belial appears behind %s and taps their shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: So jumpy. Would you put your weapon down? You can't do anything here without my permission anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just as I thought. Those mirrors around Belial...)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I just want to talk a little more. Oh? What's that Priring with a jewel beside you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm Juriring, ring?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Juriring? I couldn't see you a moment ago. Where did you come from? Was it you who avoided the mirror traps...?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring. Juriring found the mirrors, ring.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: What are you? Did Barbatos send you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring is Juriring, ring.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Juriring, Jeweling, I don't care. Get inside a mirror!
Creeeak...
(As the sound of cracking glass fades, Juriring vanishes on the spot.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring?!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링의 목소리
lines.text: Aah. I'm inside a mirror, ring. I'll try breaking it, ring. It won't break, ring.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: So noisy. Be quiet.
Creeeak...
(Juriring's voice can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Don't be too frightened. If you are, you won't be able to save a single soul in Devesis.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belial...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Why don't you quietly hear me out first, adventurer of the goddess?
(Broken mirror shards appear from nowhere, fly toward %s's throat, head, heart, and the rest of their body, then stop.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Likimo Pelke is a world inside a mirror that remembers and recreates Devesis's past.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: It holds both the time when ancient gods fought as though to devour one another, and the ruined age after the Beast consumed the gods.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Tired of stories about gods? So am I. But it can't be helped. The moment the girl you cherish became a goddess, you were all caught within them.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Countless souls in Devesis shared memories of that age. In dreams, they encountered memories cherished by the god who loved this place.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I sealed them in a mirror back then, and only now could I break that seal. Everything connected perfectly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop talking in circles and explain. Ugh...
(A sharp mirror shard aimed at the adventurer grazes their face.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Every soul in Devesis will collapse beneath the emotions of that time. Then they will naturally become mine.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: With your soul added to the collection...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belial...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I truly do want your soul. If I possess it, perhaps Barbatos will finally look at me properly.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Back then and now, he's always...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you telling me this?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe. Barbatos seems fond of you. Isn't it polite to let you know before I kill you? Huh...?
Crash!
(Mirrors suddenly shatter one after another. The sharp shards aimed at the adventurer fall to the floor and melt away.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ah, what now? Could it be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The energy inside Likimo Pelke has changed. Could it be...?)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Judging by your expression, you think you can fight me now. Such arrogance for a human...
(Belial smiles softly and touches a mirror with her fingertips. The air inside Likimo Pelke freezes in an instant.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: It was nice to meet you, %s.
(The black wings on Belial's back spread wide.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Poor little adventurer of the goddess, soon to be devoured by my mirror.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Now it begins!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Aaaagh!
(The scream of the demon who mocked the world echoes through Likimo Pelke. Her grip loosens, and her mirror starts to fall.)
(Startled, Belial barely catches it, but loses her balance and falls.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah... I need to finish this quickly...
(The adventurer attacks the opening, but Belial swiftly recovers and blocks with her mirror.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: How long has it been since I fought an evenly matched enemy...? %s, I'm so happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uuuuugh...
(Belial's power sends the adventurer flying backward.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Still trying to endure? Don't. Just accept this moment.
(As Belial flies up and prepares to smash her mirror down at the adventurer, something shining cuts through the air.)
Thwack!
(A shining arrow lodges in Belial's mirror, cracking it. The mirror shatters and falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris's arrow?)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: N-no...
(Belial tries to catch the falling mirror fragments, but they turn to dust in her hands and scatter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now!)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Aaaagh!
(The adventurer's blow sends Belial flying with a scream of pain.)
Thud!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: How irritating... That was my favorite mirror... A mere Der arrow... It seems our goddess opened the great wall to interfere...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: ...It won't go as you wish, goddess. I'll show you what happens to your precious human.
(Countless mirrors, seemingly hidden within Likimo Pelke, float into the air.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I have all the mirrors I need... Gah...
(Belial's face twists, and she coughs up blood. The floating mirrors melt and flow to the ground.)
(Through them appears someone gripping Belial's throat with one hand, making no effort to hide his displeasure.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s, I'll borrow Belial for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Don't do this, Barbatos. I did it for you...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You crossed the line.
(Barbatos hurls Belial into the remaining large mirror.)
Crash!
(With the sound of shattering glass, every visible scene sinks into darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Aaaaaah! Help, ring! Oh, I'm alive, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, how did you get out?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Belial went crash into the mirror, ring. So I went pop out of it, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we do now? It's not over yet...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Look, over there, ring.
(Juriring grabs the adventurer and pushes them forward. Something enormous blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: This mirror is safe, ring. Just watch, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mirror... Oh...?
(The mirror before the adventurer glows faintly, showing the two figures.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I believe I clearly told you to do nothing.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I only wanted to give you what you wanted. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: So you disturbed me while I was living quietly in the Demon Realm and drove me berserk? Dropped me in Glaston and made me kill an emperor who had nothing to do with it?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Thanks to that, you learned how Lux intended to use the witch.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Belial, how long have you been using me?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Since you were Kaulini...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kaulini?!)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You were so beautiful, whispering to living beings on Cloud Hill.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: But the other gods feared you because you knew the Beast. They joined forces and turned you into a human.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Even as a human, they feared you enough to try to kill you. Remember how all the lives you loved died then?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: The age of Cloud Hill you knew disappeared.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: So I couldn't stand by. I helped you. I made those memories into Likimo Pelke so you could see them someday. What do you think?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: With that help, the one deceived by a demon killed a god. As punishment, he fell into the Demon Realm and lost his memories...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He couldn't even protect the spirit who fought for him. She succumbed to the demon's trickery and fell...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: 'Despair' suited you so well after you fell into the Demon Realm. You liked it too, didn't you? Barbatos, Grand Duke of Despair!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe. Everything was so perfect that I waited. For the day you would rise again...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ahaha... So you waited thousands of years...? Mad demon...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hahahaha. Hahahahahaha!

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I love you, Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Of all the beings in this world who know you, I've known you the longest. Your only love. Yes, I will be your last.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Heh. Ridiculous. Such unsuitable words from a demon's mouth... Now that is deception.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Belial.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You don't love me. You want the power I had as a god.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: To me, they're the same, Barbatos. I meant to wait a little longer...
(Belial's gaze turns cold.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ah, I'm not in the mood now. Barbatos... No, Kaulini. Don't forget. I will be beside you at your final moment.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: And I will trap this world you loved inside a mirror and defile it. Along with that adventurer.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe. Of all places, you brought me inside a mirror...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Belial!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You leave me no choice but to become Kaulini again. Ellone, too... Yes, I...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, snap out of it, ring!
Crash!
(The sounds of mirrors and sharp fragments shattering echo from every direction.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: We need to leave now, ring! Likimo Pelke is collapsing, ring!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But we haven't defeated Belial yet...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The goddess's arrow broke Belial's evil mirror, so it's all right, ring. The demonic power is gone, ring. Let's survive first, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Oh, this is...
(The adventurer notices something shining at Juriring's feet.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, take this, ring. A mirror showing Cloud Hill, ring. We need it to get out, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We need this mirror? Another mirror? Aaaah, what are you doing, Juriring?
(Juriring grabs the adventurer and tosses them onto its shoulders.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I have to save you, ring. That's what Juriring must do, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Juriring. Let's return to Devesis.
(Carrying the adventurer, Juriring leaps high toward a gap in a broken mirror, spreads its folded wings wide, and begins flying powerfully.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Hold tight, ring!

steps.name: An Adventurer Buried in Clouds
steps.objective: Talk to [Marta] in 「Devesis」 and watch all the events that follow. Then turn in the quest to [Juriring] in 「Whispering Hill」.

lines.text: (Marta watches the structure before her, then steps back in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: (The invisible barrier is collapsing... The ominous presence is disappearing, too...)
(An enormous shadow appears in the air and drops straight to the ground.)
Crash!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah... Are we back?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, wake up, ring. I'm not hitting your head, so stop holding it, ring. We're back, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marta. I'm fine. I'm back safely.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The evil presence surrounding Devesis has vanished... And I can no longer read this book... That must have been the end.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm glad, ring. That's how it should be, ring. Oh, %s, give Marta the mirror, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The mirror? Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: A mirror?
(Marta takes the mirror from %s and falls speechless.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Marta, are you all right, ring?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Juriring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, you can see me, ring?!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Of course I can... We promised to meet again... Why did you only appear now?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I was always in Devesis, ring. I came often because I missed you, Marta, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: So that bird that kept appearing was you...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, ring.
(Marta extends her hand. Juriring approaches and happily rubs against her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew Juriring, too, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: It was a Priring only I could see, ever since I came here...

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: After the glass wall of that world broke and I obtained this book, I couldn't see it anymore.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Juriring, it seems there's something I must do with this mirror.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right, Marta, ring. I have a favor to ask, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Give the memories in this mirror to %s, ring. That will help the goddess. Devesis won't be in danger anymore, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're not asking anything else.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Juriring asked me to trust it back then, too. Because I did, I was able to protect Devesis.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Thank you, Marta, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Juriring, as you know, I have no magic left. Sharing memories won't be easy...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It's all right, ring. I'll help, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: All right. What should we do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're not going to hit my head with the jewel, are you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, a good idea, ring. But no, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Marta and %s, the two who will share the memories, hold the mirror, ring. I'll handle the rest, ring.
(Following Juriring's instructions, Marta and the adventurer hold opposite ends of the mirror. Juriring lifts its jewel and strikes the mirror.)
Crash.
(The impact shatters the mirror. Its fragments turn to powder, scatter on the wind around the Tower of Sages, and vanish without a trace.)
(At that moment, someone's memories enter %s's mind with unprecedented clarity.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Finished, ring. %s, come back to your senses, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... Hm?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm not holding anything over your head, %s, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it all right for me to remember this? These are someone else's memories...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The goddess needs to know, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The memories of those who loved this place strengthened Devesis's magical barrier, ring. Evil demons can no longer come here, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: That's wonderful, Juriring.
(Marta gently strokes the head of the brightly smiling Juriring.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It really is, ring.
(Juriring gazes steadily at the two of them.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Goodbye, ring. You two won't be able to see Juriring anymore, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring is a Priring only those protecting Devesis can see, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Once that's over, you can't see me anymore, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It's been that way since I came into this world, so I don't know the details, ring. That's why I couldn't answer, ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Juriring... So that's why you disappeared back then...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Juriring isn't disappearing, ring. I'll be in Devesis, ring. I'll keep cheering for Devesis, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring? Juriring?!
(Juriring's figure grows increasingly faint.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Juriring...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Goodbye. Take care, ring.
(As Juriring disappears, a familiar-looking sphere of warm light descends before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this light...
(Juriring lies in the grass, looking at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It's so sad that people can't see me, ring. I waited so long for someone who could...
(Just then, %s's face comes into Juriring's view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, where are you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You can't see me even if you call, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juriring, Juriring. Answer me.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Keep calling all you want. Even if I answer, you won't see or hear me, ring.
Growl...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, I'm hungry, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better stop looking for Juriring. Shall I take a break?
(The adventurer settles down and spreads out the food they prepared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Too many sandwiches and snacks to eat alone...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow, that looks delicious, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I need someone to share them with.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Should I pretend to be a ghost and steal some, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't do that. Come eat. There's some for you.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: May I, ring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Whaaaaaat!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't panic. Careful with the jewel.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You can see me, ring?
Poke.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Don't poke my belly, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see you clearly. And touch you, too.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Aaaaah...
(Juriring covers its face with the jewel and hides behind a nearby rock. But its body is so big that a wing sticks out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You call that hiding?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm embarrassed, ring. Now I'm just a Priring who gave a dramatic goodbye, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris says thank you for helping, and she'll grant your wish. You don't need to hide from Marta or me anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here, eat.
(The adventurer pulls Juriring over and places a sandwich in front of it.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What do I do after eating this, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to do anything. I asked Iris about you.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What did the goddess say, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An ordinary Priring that liked eating and playing was affected by the magic in Devesis, and came to live a very long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Over time, you became something like a Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: See, ring? Juriring is Juriring, ring. Juriring who used to be a Priring, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were you a little Priring at first?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Little and cute, ring. Now I'm big and cute, ring. I got a jewel as a gift and played with the birds, and became like this, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A jewel as a gift? Who gave it to you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A strange-looking person, ring. Looked like that person passing over there, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How strange-looking? Wait. Someone passing over there?
(Startled by Juriring's words, the adventurer looks down the hill. A boy below meets their eyes, apparently recognizing them.)
(The adventurer hurries down the hill, but the boy is nowhere to be found.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-where did he go?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It was that person, ring. But where did he go, ring? There's nowhere to go from here, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, yes, Goddess. Yes, understood, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Who are you talking to? Iris?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It's Iris, ring. When the time comes, I'll tell %s about Barbatos... who used to be Kaulini, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? When?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Who knows, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. All right...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Aren't you asking more, ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'd just say 'Juriring is Juriring' anyway. You've been Juriring from the start, after all...

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right. Juriring is Juriring, ring.
(Juriring approaches and rubs against the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I want to go to the village, ring. Let's see Marta, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm sure I've seen that person somewhere before... Who was he? I can't remember at all... I'll have to ask Iris later...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At least Iris said Devesis is safe now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kaulini...)
